hypothesis: A fixed-budget policy that diversifies late public sensor coverage across cases, with a public residual-triggered remembered recheck, reduces onset physical matching mismatches on previously unseen nonanchor swaps relative to native fixed sensing, while maintaining zero steady-state mismatches.
claim_limit: Public-only synthetic Y070 matching experiments, not unrestricted native cognition or RSI

parent_negative.reason: F4 fixed sensor set of 8,11 was structurally blind to its 6/9 and 12/14 pairs; F5 diversifies prospective coverage without reading evaluator pair at inference.

proposed_arms.mechanism: Native Y070 fixed anchor sampling at episodes 0,1,3 and sensors 2,4 at episodes 5,7; common public-only decoder
Public anchor-derived rotation over 14 nonanchor physical addresses, four distinct late observations per trial; common public-only decoder
Same public anchor coverage pair at episode 5; publicly observed residual anomaly causes remembered sensor recheck at 7, otherwise scan two new addresses; common public-only decoder

development.rules: Independent non-overlapping preregistered cohort; never reuse F3/F4 reserved seeds
development.selection: Development-only bounded model selection with deterministic fail-closed tie; do not tune after sealed result
development.source_fidelity: Independent public-value trace replay and no-oracle source review

sealed.pair_rule: Unknown-swap distribution must include multiple nonanchor pair locations and avoid cherry-picking positions intersecting the candidate coverage; independent preregistered evaluator-side sampling and hidden physical source
sealed.evaluation_unit: source_family x matching_policy x sealed_seed x nonanchor_pair x steady/onset1
sealed.primary_endpoint: Total mismatch episodes and pre-detection mismatch episodes by pair, then worst-pair effect
sealed.falsification: A valid negative if no reliable worst-pair improvement under fixed cost, or any steady harm; store negative without retuning
